name: TeamStarWolf - The Year 2007 in Intrusions (ICS)
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. ATT&CK for ICS techniques for Stuxnet 0.5, which Symantec's 2013 analysis dates to November 2007 and which spread only through infected Siemens Step 7 project files. No 2007 source prints an ATT&CK id, and ATT&CK lists T0873.001 for Stuxnet (S0603) from the 1.x analysis, so tying both entries to the 0.5 version is this study's later mapping. Each comment names source numbers from case-studies/CHRONICLE_2007.md. Scores: 70 the source describes the behavior and the study assigns the id.
